name: togglr-sdk-typescript
description: TypeScript SDK for Togglr feature flag management system

scripts.generate-client: openapi-generator-cli generate -i specs/sdk.yml -g typescript-axios -o src/generated --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withNodeImports=true,typescriptThreePlus=true && node scripts/fix-exact-optional-properties.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run generate-client && npm run build

author: Roman Chudov
